description: Bilköpskollen estimates what a used car costs to own in Sweden, not what it costs to buy. Give it a Blocket listing or the car's details and it returns the total over a chosen number of years and yearly mileage, broken down into depreciation, fuel or electricity, insurance, vehicle tax, service and repairs. It can compare two cars and say which is cheaper and by how much. Every answer links to the full report on bilkopskollen.se, where the assumptions can be changed.

defaultPrompt: Vad kostar en Volvo V60 D4 från 2019 att äga i tre år? Den kostar 245 000 kr och har gått 18 000 mil.
Jämför vad en Tesla Model 3 och en Volvo V60 diesel kostar att äga i fem år vid 2 000 mil om året.
